items.source:
There is no necessity for Spring applications to depend
on ApplicationContext or even BeanFactory functionality
explicitly. One of the strengths of the Spring architecture
is that application objects can often be configured without
any dependency on Spring-specific APIs.
items.translation: Spring 应用程序无需显式依赖 ApplicationContext 甚至 BeanFactory 功能。Spring 架构的优势之一在于，应用程序对象通常可以在不依赖 Spring 特定 API 的情况下进行配置。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified of the MessageSource (typically the ApplicationContext) that it runs in.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行所在的 MessageSource（通常是 ApplicationContext）通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: An ApplicationEvent that carries an arbitrary payload.
items.translation: 携带任意负载的 `ApplicationEvent`。

items.source: Callback interface for initializing a Spring ConfigurableApplicationContext prior to being refreshed.
items.translation: 用于在刷新之前初始化 Spring ConfigurableApplicationContext 的回调接口。

items.source: An extension of the Lifecycle interface for those objects that require to be started upon ApplicationContext refresh and/or shutdown in a particular order.
items.translation: 一个扩展了Lifecycle接口的接口，适用于那些需要在ApplicationContext刷新和/或关闭时按特定顺序启动的对象。

items.source: Load-time weaving support for a Spring application context, building on Spring's LoadTimeWeaver abstraction.
items.translation: 支持 Spring 应用程序上下文的加载时织入，基于 Spring 的 LoadTimeWeaver 抽象。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified of the ApplicationContext that it runs in.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行的ApplicationContext通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified of the ApplicationStartup that it runs with.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行的 ApplicationStartup 通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any bean that wishes to be notified of the Environment that it runs in.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行环境的Environment通知的 Bean 都必须实现此接口。

items.source: Interface for objects that are suitable for message resolution in a MessageSource.
items.translation: 适用于在 `MessageSource` 中进行消息解析的对象接口。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified of the ResourceLoader (typically the ApplicationContext) that it runs in.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行环境中的 ResourceLoader（通常是 ApplicationContext）通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified of a StringValueResolver for the resolution of embedded definition values.
items.translation: 任何希望被通知以获取用于解析嵌入定义值的 StringValueResolver 的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

items.source: AOT support for application contexts.
items.translation: 应用上下文的 AOT 支持。

items.source:
Support package for advanced application context configuration,
with XML schema being the primary configuration format.
items.translation: 用于高级应用程序上下文配置的辅助包，其中 XML 架构为主要配置格式。

items.source: Support classes for application events, like standard context events.
items.translation: 支持应用程序事件（如标准上下文事件）的类。

items.source: Expression parsing support within a Spring application context.
items.translation: Spring 应用程序上下文中的表达式解析支持。

items.source:
Abstraction for determining the current Locale,
plus global holder that exposes a thread-bound Locale.
items.translation: 用于确定当前区域的抽象类，以及一个提供线程绑定区域的全局持有者。

items.source: Support package for reading and managing the components index.
items.translation: 用于读取和管理组件索引的支持包。

items.source:
Classes supporting the org.springframework.context package,
such as abstract base classes for ApplicationContext
implementations and a MessageSource implementation.
items.translation: 支持 `org.springframework.context` 包的类，例如 `ApplicationContext` 实现的抽象基类和 `MessageSource` 实现。

items.source: Central interface to provide configuration for an application.
items.translation: 提供应用程序配置的中央接口。

items.source: Exception thrown during application context initialization.
items.translation: 应用程序上下文初始化期间抛出异常。

items.source: Class to be extended by all application events.
items.translation: 所有应用程序事件要扩展的类。

items.source: Interface that encapsulates event publication functionality.
items.translation: 封装事件发布功能的接口。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified
of the ApplicationEventPublisher (typically the ApplicationContext)
that it runs in.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行的 ApplicationContext（通常是 ApplicationEventPublisher）通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by application event listeners.
items.translation: 应用程序事件监听器需实现的接口。

items.source: SPI interface to be implemented by most if not all application contexts.
items.translation: 由大多数甚至所有应用程序上下文实现的 SPI 接口。

items.source:
Sub-interface of MessageSource to be implemented by objects that
can resolve messages hierarchically.
items.translation: 可分层解析消息的对象的 MessageSource 子接口。

items.source: A common interface defining methods for start/stop lifecycle control.
items.translation: 定义用于启动/停止生命周期控制的常用接口。

items.source: Strategy interface for processing Lifecycle beans within the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 用于在 ApplicationContext 中处理生命周期 Bean 的策略接口。

items.source:
Strategy interface for resolving messages, with support for the parameterization
and internationalization of such messages.
items.translation: 用于解析消息的策略接口，支持此类消息的参数化和国际化。

items.source: Exception thrown when a message can't be resolved.
items.translation: 消息无法解析时抛出异常。

items.source:
Interface for objects that may participate in a phased
process such as lifecycle management.
items.translation: 可能参与分阶段过程（如生命周期管理）的对象接口。
